plugin-load-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' could not be loaded.
authme-shutdown-problem: The plugin 'AuthMe' fails to load and shuts the server down.
pex-config-problem: The configuration of the plugin 'PermissionsEx' is invalid.
ambiguous-plugin-name-problem: There are multiple plugin files for the plugin name '{{plugin-name}}': '{{first-plugin-path}}' and '{{second-plugin-path}}'.
plugin-dependency-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' is missing the required plugin '{{dependency-plugin-name}}'.
plugin-dependencies-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' is missing the required plugins {{dependency-plugin-names}}.
plugin-disabling-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' could not be disabled.
plugin-enabling-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' could not be enabled.
plugin-runtime-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' has a problem while running.
forge-confirm-problem: Forge requires your confirmation to apply changes and start the server.
mod-dependency-problem: The mod '{{mod-name}}' is missing the required mod {{dependency-mod-name}}.
mod-dependency-problem-plural: The mod '{{mod-name}}' is missing the required mods {{dependency-mod-list}}.
mod-duplicate-problem: There are multiple mod files for the mod name '{{mod-name}}': '{{first-mod-path}}' and '{{second-mod-path}}'.
mod-duplicate-problem-no-path: There are multiple mod files for the mod name '{{mod-name}}'.
non-fabric-mod-problem: The file '{{file-name}}' in the mods folder is not a Fabric mod and is ignored by Fabric Loader.
mod-file-corrupt-problem: The mod file '{{file-path}}' is corrupt or incomplete.
mod-exception-problem: The mod '{{mod-name}}' has thrown an exception.
mod-fatal-problem: The mod '{{mod-name}}' has a fatal error.
mod-packet-codec-problem: A network packet of the mod '{{mod-name}}' could not be sent or read. The mod probably has different versions on the client and the server.
mixin-config-fatal-problem: The mod with the mixin config '{{mixin-config}}' has a fatal error.
world-missing-mod-problem: The world was saved with mod '{{mod-name}}' which appears to be missing.
world-mod-version-problem: This world was saved with mod '{{mod-name}}' version {{mod-expected-version}} and it is now at version {{mod-current-version}}.
plugin-incompatible-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' is incompatible with your current server version.
aquatic-world-on-older-version-problem: The current world was created/loaded with Minecraft 1.13 or higher. The new format cannot be loaded in any older version.
old-player-directory-problem: The server has detected an old player directory in the world save.
plugin-install-different-version-solutio: Install a different version of the plugin '{{plugin-name}}'.
plugin-with-class-install-different-vers: Install a different version of the plugin that contains the class '{{class-name}}'.
plugin-with-class-remove-solution: Remove the plugin that contains the class '{{class-name}}'.
mod-install-different-version-solution: Install a different version of the mod '{{mod-name}}'.
aquatic-version-install-solution: Update the server software to 1.13 or newer.
plugin-command-exception-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' cannot execute the command '{{command}}'.
ticking-block-entity-problem: A block in the world is causing problems.
remove-block-solution: Remove the block from the world, e.g. with MCEdit.
do-nothing-solution: Do nothing. This problem might fix itself.
chunk-load-exception-problem: There was an exception while loading the world chunks.
remove-chunk-solution: Remove the problematic chunk from the world, e.g. with MCEdit or by removing the region file.
multiverse-load-problem: The world '{{world-name}}' could not be loaded because it contains errors and is probably corrupt.
world-repair-solution: Repair the world '{{world-name}}', e.g. by using Minecraft Region Fixer or MCEdit.
world-duplicate-problem: World '{{world-name}}' is a duplicate of another world and has been prevented from loading.
mod-wrong-minecraft-version-problem: The mod '{{mod-name}}' is not compatible with the Minecraft version {{minecraft-version}}.
malformed-encoding-problem: Something (probably the MOTD) contains malformed formatting codes.
code-of-conduct-folder-missing-problem: The Code of Conduct folder does not exist.
bedrock-authentication-whitelist-problem: Using a whitelist without online authentication is not allowed.
bedrock-authentication-allowlist-problem: Using an allowlist without online authentication is not allowed.
undefined-mod-dependency-problem: A mod is missing the required mod {{dependency-mod-name}}.
version-downgrade-problem: Your world was used on a newer version before.
version-downgrade-solution: Install a newer version of Minecraft.
bedrock-dbstorage-chain-problem: Unable to decrypt world. Marketplace worlds can't be installed on dedicated servers.
server-install-different-version-solutio: Install the version '{{software-version}}' of your server software.
plugin-api-version-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' needs version '{{software-version}}' of your server software.
legacy-plugin-conversion-problem: The legacy plugin '{{plugin-name}}' could not be converted for this server version.
plugin-java-version-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' requires Java version {{java-version}} or later to run.
mod-java-version-problem: The mod '{{mod-name}}' requires Java version {{java-version}} or later to run.
change-java-version-solution: Change your Java version to {{java-version}} or later.
ticking-entity-problem: The entity '{{name}}' at the location {{location}} is causing issues while ticking.
remove-entity-solution: Remove the entity '{{name}}' at the location {{location}}.
plugin-regional-ticking-problem: The plugin {{plugin-name}} does not support regional ticking.
install-non-regional-ticking-software-so: Install a software without regional ticking, like {{software-name}}.
forge-language-provider-version-problem: The mod '{{mod-file}}' requires '{{required-version}}', but '{{found-version}}' is installed.
plugin-api-version-lower-than-allowed-pr: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' has an API version specified that is lower than the minimum allowed version.
change-minimum-api-version-solution: Change 'minimum-api' in bukkit.yml to {{api-version}}, lower or even 'none'.
auth-server-problem: The Mojang/Microsoft authentication servers are currently unreachable!
auth-server-solution: Wait a few minutes and try again. If the issue persists, check the official Mojang/Microsoft channels for any known authentication server problems.
missing-datapack-mod-problem: Datapack is missing, because the mod '{{mod-name}}' may not be installed.
datapack-parsing-problem: The datapack '{{datapack}}' could not be parsed.
server-jar-in-plugin-folder-problem: The server jar '{{file-path}}' is in the plugins folder. Server jars do not belong in the plugins folder.
unregistered-classloader-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' was enabled through a classloader that is not registered with Paper. The plugin is loading other plugins on its own.
plugin-update-copy-problem: The plugin file '{{source-path}}' could not be copied to '{{target-path}}' during the update process.
plugin-update-rename-problem: The plugin file '{{source-path}}' could not be renamed to '{{target-path}}' during the update process.
plugin-update-delete-problem: The plugin file '{{source-path}}' could not be deleted from the update folder during the update process.
misconfigured-update-directory-non-direc: The update directory '{{path}}' is not a directory. Auto updating will not work.
misconfigured-update-directory-same-prob: The update directory '{{path}}' is the same location as the plugin directory '{{plugin-path}}'. Auto updating is disabled.
misconfigured-update-directory-access-pr: The server could not access the plugin update folder or the plugins folder. Plugin updates placed in the update folder will not be installed.
plugin-name-conflict-problem: Multiple plugins use the plugin name '{{name}}'. Only one of them can be loaded.
plugin-bootstrapper-problem: The bootstrapper of the plugin '{{plugin-path}}' failed. The plugin will not be loaded.
plugin-data-folder-not-directory-problem: The data folder '{{path}}' for the plugin '{{plugin-name}}' exists, but it is not a directory.
plugin-data-folder-rename-problem: The old data folder '{{path}}' could not be renamed to '{{new-path}}'.
plugin-without-descriptor-problem: The file '{{file-path}}' is not a valid plugin, because it contains neither a plugin.yml nor a paper-plugin.yml.
event-listener-missing-class-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' could not register the event listener '{{listener}}', because the class '{{missing-class}}' it references does not exist.
client-only-mod-problem: The mod '{{mod-name}}' cannot run on a server. It is either a client-only mod or uses client-only code.
restricted-plugin-name-problem: A plugin has a name that is not allowed.
invalid-event-handler-signature-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' declares the event handler '{{signature}}' in '{{class-name}}' with an invalid signature. Paper ignores this method.
paper-newer-config-file-problem: The Paper config file '{{file-path}}' was created by a newer Paper version (config version {{config-version}}, this server supports up to {{supported-version}}). Settings in it might not work.
paper-newer-world-config-problem: The Paper config file of the world '{{world-name}}' was created by a newer Paper version (config version {{config-version}}, this server supports up to {{supported-version}}). Settings in it might not work.
paper-config-reset-solution: Back up and delete the file '{{file-path}}'. Paper creates it again with default settings.
paper-world-config-reset-solution: Back up and delete the file 'paper-world.yml' of the world '{{world-name}}'. Paper creates it again with default settings.
paper-install-newer-version-solution: Install the newer Paper version that created this config file.
mod-fabric-loader-version-problem: The mod '{{mod-name}}' requires Fabric Loader version {{loader-version}} or later, but version {{installed-version}} is installed.
fabric-loader-update-solution: Update Fabric Loader to version {{loader-version}} or later.
fabric-server-jar-missing-problem: The Minecraft server jar '{{file-path}}' is missing, but Fabric needs it to start.
fabric-server-jar-provide-solution: Place the official Minecraft server jar of the matching version at '{{file-path}}' or change 'serverJar' in fabric-server-launcher.properties to its location.
paper-config-not-writable-problem: The configuration file '{{path}}' could not be saved. Settings missing from the file use their default values.
paper-world-defaults-missing-problem: The file '{{path}}' with the default world settings does not exist. Paper cannot load new worlds without it.
paper-world-defaults-restore-solution: Restore the file '{{path}}' from a backup or restart the server to create it again with default values.
paper-velocity-secret-missing-problem: Velocity forwarding is enabled in '{{file-path}}', but no secret is set. Players cannot join through the Velocity proxy.
enum-compatibility-mode-problem: The enum compatibility mode is enabled, which makes all plugins slower.
bukkit-yml-disable-setting-solution: Update your plugins and set '{{setting}}' in 'bukkit.yml' to 'false'.
paper-velocity-secret-set-solution: Set '{{setting}}' in '{{file-path}}' to the forwarding secret of your Velocity proxy, which is in the file 'forwarding.secret' of the proxy.
default-world-plugin-missing-problem: The setting '{{setting}}' of the world '{{world-name}}' in 'bukkit.yml' uses the plugin '{{plugin-name}}', but the plugin is not installed.
default-world-plugin-not-enabled-problem: The setting '{{setting}}' of the world '{{world-name}}' in 'bukkit.yml' uses the plugin '{{plugin-name}}', but the plugin is not enabled before the worlds are loaded.
default-world-plugin-not-provided-proble: The setting '{{setting}}' of the world '{{world-name}}' in 'bukkit.yml' uses the plugin '{{plugin-name}}', but the plugin does not support this setting.
bukkit-yml-world-setting-solution: Check the setting '{{setting}}' of the world '{{world-name}}' in 'bukkit.yml'.
legacy-plugin-problem: The plugin '{{plugin-name}}' was made for Minecraft versions before 1.13 and might not work correctly.
help-yml-invalid-problem: The file '{{file-path}}' is not valid YAML. The server ignores it and uses the default help topics.
map-renderer-problem: The map renderer '{{class-name}}' of a plugin has thrown an exception, so maps are not drawn correctly.
permissions-file-invalid-problem: The permissions file '{{file-path}}' is not valid YAML. The server ignores all permissions in it.
permissions-file-already-defined-problem: The permission '{{permission}}' in '{{file-path}}' is already defined by the server or a plugin.
watchdog-problem: The main thread of the server is blocked, so the watchdog logged a thread dump.
watchdog-thread-dump-solution: Look for plugins in the thread dump of the 'Server thread' below the message, and update or remove the plugin that blocks the server.
paper-cache-dir-problem: Paper cannot use its cache folder '{{path}}'. The server cannot start without it.
paper-configuration-parse-problem: The Paper configuration file '{{file-path}}' is not valid YAML. The error is in line {{line}}, column {{column}}.
paper-configuration-parse-unknown-file-p: A Paper configuration file is not valid YAML.
paper-configuration-syntax-fix-solution: Fix the YAML syntax in '{{file-path}}' in line {{line}}, column {{column}}, for example the indentation.
main-thread-check-problem: The thread '{{thread-name}}' tried to do '{{action}}' outside of the main thread of the server, which is not allowed.
invalid-enum-value-problem: A Paper configuration file contains the invalid value '{{value}}'. Allowed values are: {{allowed-values}}.
use-valid-enum-value-solution: Search the Paper configuration files for '{{value}}' and replace it with one of the allowed values.
world-data-corrupted-problem: The server could not load the world data. The world files are probably corrupted.
server-icon-invalid-problem: The server icon '{{file-path}}' could not be loaded. It must be a PNG image of 64x64 pixels.
out-of-memory-error-problem: The server ran out of memory ('{{memory-area}}').
plugin-memory-usage-solution: Remove plugins that use a lot of memory.
mod-memory-usage-solution: Remove mods that use a lot of memory.
